verdict: Leads are up sharply; turning them into cases is the active priority.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 76 leads at a cost of $23.92 per lead — a volume surge of roughly 340% compared to the prior 7-day period, with spend running at about $88 per day. That cost per lead sits comfortably within your historical range of $19–$45, so the ads are performing. The gap to address is downstream: none of those 76 leads have moved into an active case opportunity in the CRM, which means intake — not the advertising — is where leads are stalling. Two items are needed to fix that pipeline visibility: SMS automation and phone system access, both of which are being escalated this week. Once those are in place, full lead-to-case tracking goes live by September 30, and you'll have a clear cost-per-case number to guide scaling decisions in October.

cost per lead this period, within your historical range
